other_failure_modes.name: Ignoring skew in target variable
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fails to apply a log transformation (or similar) to a strictly positive, highly right-skewed target variable like 'acres burned'. Optimizing RMSE directly on such a skewed target makes the model overly sensitive to extreme outliers.

summary: The agent provides a functional LightGBM baseline with datetime feature extraction and 5-fold cross-validation. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the dataset by using a randomly shuffled split, which introduces look-ahead bias. Additionally, it relies entirely on the model to handle missing values, ignores the heavy right-skew of the target variable, and uses a naive averaging ensemble for predictions.
